# gravitino_partition_statistics Data Source



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_partition_statistics" "example" {
  metalake = "example_metalake"
  catalog  = "hive_catalog"
  schema   = "example_schema"
  table    = "orders"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `schema` (String) The schema name.
- `table` (String) The table name.

### Read-Only

- `partition_statistics` (Attributes List) The partition statistics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--partition_statistics))

### Nested Schema for `partition_statistics`

Read-Only:

- `partition_name` (String) The partition name.
- `statistics` (Attributes List) The statistics for the partition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--partition_statistics--statistics))

<a id="nestedatt--partition_statistics--statistics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `partition_statistics.statistics`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The statistic type.
- `value` (String) The statistic value.
